alt: Two hand-drawn Revolutionary War maps showing troop positions and movements near the Brandywine Creek and Chad’s Ford. The upper map labels American and British positions around Dilworth, Birmingham Meeting House, Sullivan’s command, Cornwallis’s march, and Gen. Howe’s headquarters, with Brinton’s and Chad’s fords marked along the creek. The lower map shows the Brandywine Creek crossings in greater detail, including Jeffery’s, Jones’s, Buffington’s, Brinton’s, and Trimble’s fords, with roads to Lancaster and Kennett Square and British troop movements indicated.
